crime: Every evening, {WITCH_NAME}'s roommate went out to the flower field and flew a kite she had made herself, sending it high over the roof. Each night she described how high it had flown, talking on until {WITCH_NAME} fell asleep.
One night at lockup, she smiled from her bunk in their cell. "Tomorrow I'm cutting it loose for my brother. Then you can finally sleep without my kite stories."
{WITCH_NAME}'s father had flown a kite with her only once. That evening he cut her kite loose. "Some things fly better let go," he said. By morning he was gone, and the house was silent.

At dusk on the day her roommate meant to cut the kite loose, while it was still up, {WITCH_NAME} walked out to the flower field alone. She pressed her roommate's face into the flowers beside the staked reel, beneath the rising line, and held her down until she was still. Then she gave the reel one slow turn and walked back. Her Magic kept it turning, winding in the line at a steady pace all on its own.

From the courtyard, the prisoners watched the kite come steadily down and drop behind the roof. {WITCH_NAME} had been standing among them since it was still riding high. Before lockup, they found her roommate dead, face down beside the staked reel.

On the morning of the trial, the prisoners agreed on what they had seen: the girl had been alive, reeling her kite in until it came down, while {WITCH_NAME} stood with them. Then one prisoner noticed a thin scorch mark across the back of the dead girl's coat, where the kite line had been dragged over it toward the reel. The line had been wound in over her after she fell. The prisoners realized the reel had been running on {WITCH_NAME}'s Magic since before she joined them.
fields.epitaph: The quiet she feared would still have had someone breathing in it.
fields.epithet: The Child Still Holding the Cut String
execution: The execution stand raises a giant reel, staked upright, with her bound along its drum. At the far end of its line, a giant kite lies on the trial court floor.
The reel begins to turn by itself at a steady pace, winding the line over her and drawing the kite across the floor.
It keeps winding. Layer upon layer of line tightens around her chest.
The kite reaches the spool, and the reel stops. She lies still under the wound line.

magic.name: Never Winding Down
magic.text: Anything she sets in motion keeps going without ever slowing, until she lets it stop.
